entities.summary: Bryant DeJuan Crawford is an American professional basketball player for Löwen Braunschweig of the Basketball Bundesliga (BBL). He played college basketball for the Wake Forest Demon Deacons. Standing at 6 ft 3 in (1.91 m), he plays at the point guard position.
